title: The computational and neural substrates of moral strategies in social decision-making

items.verbatim_quote: previous neuroimaging studies have averaged measurements across participants, potentially masking individual differences in implicit moral reasoning, and hence obscuring strategy-specific features of the moral brain.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评以往的神经影像研究：对参与者进行平均测量，可能掩盖了内隐道德推理的个体差异，从而模糊了道德大脑的策略特异性特征。
items.target_of_critique: previous neuroimaging studies on moral decision-making

items.verbatim_quote: An obvious downside of this approach is that we could not control the relative frequencies of moral strategies in our dataset, which contained a relatively low number of purely guilt-averse participants.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认该方法的一个明显缺点是，他们无法控制数据集中道德策略的相对频率，其中纯粹内疚厌恶的参与者数量相对较少。

items.verbatim_quote: It is important to note that smaller groups have less power.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，较小的组统计效力较低。

items.verbatim_quote: several important questions remain open. First, in most laboratory paradigms, guilt aversion and inequity aversion yield the same behavioral predictions, obfuscating which prosocial motivation was at play in the decision-maker’s mind (as noted by Nihonsugi et al. 14 and Hein et al. 15). Therefore, one important outstanding question is whether these two motivations can be uncoupled behaviorally. Second, the stability of moral strategies is largely unknown. Do people behave consistently across different instances of moral dilemmas or is their decision-making a product of the particular context they are facing? Finally, and crucially, previous neuroimaging studies have averaged measurements across participants, potentially masking individual differences in implicit moral reasoning, and hence obscuring strategy-specific features of the moral brain.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出几个重要问题尚未解决：首先，在多数实验室范式中，内疚厌恶和不公平厌恶产生相同的行为预测，难以区分决策者的亲社会动机；其次，道德策略的稳定性尚不清楚；最后，以往的神经影像研究对参与者进行平均，可能掩盖了个体差异，从而模糊了道德大脑的策略特异性特征。

items.verbatim_quote: in most laboratory paradigms, guilt aversion and inequity aversion yield the same behavioral predictions, obfuscating which prosocial motivation was at play in the decision-maker’s mind (as noted by Nihonsugi et al. 14 and Hein et al. 15).
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评以往实验室范式：内疚厌恶和不公平厌恶产生相同的行为预测，混淆了决策者真正的亲社会动机。
items.target_of_critique: prior laboratory paradigms for guilt aversion and inequity aversion

raw_item.verbatim_quote: our inferences about moral strategies required the use of a task in which different social preference models yield different behavioral predictions (i.e., The Hidden Multiplier Trust Game). This variant of the canonical Trust Game allowed us to disentangle neural processes related to different motivational signals, which would have been conflated in the traditional version of the task.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，他们对道德策略的推断依赖于使用隐藏乘数信任博弈这一特定任务变体，该任务能够分离不同动机信号的神经过程，而传统信任博弈则会混淆这些信号。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: We hope to better understand these nuances of the model as well as cultural specificity of the moral strategies in future work.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者希望在未来工作中更好地理解模型的这些细微差别以及道德策略的文化特异性。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: First, how stable are moral strategies across tasks? If participants use the same moral strategy throughout different contexts, tasks, and time points, this might reflect a trait-like “moral phenotype” anchored in participants’ enduring social preferences.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者提出未来研究应探讨道德策略在不同任务间的稳定性，如果参与者在不同情境、任务和时间点使用相同的道德策略，这可能反映一种类似特质的“道德表型”。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: Second, do decision strategies inferred from behavior correspond to participants’ subjective experiences? Although there is evidence that participants are generally unable to accurately report their internal cognitive processes, it would be interesting to explore the subjective reasoning of participants whose strategy lacks internal consistency (e.g., moral opportunists).
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究探索从行为推断的决策策略是否与参与者的主观体验相符，特别是对于策略缺乏内部一致性的参与者（如道德机会主义者）的主观推理。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: Third, what leads to the development of a mix of moral strategies in a population? In many human social interactions, moral opportunism may be the most adaptive strategy, as it allows participants to maximize payoff while still being able to justify their decision to others —a key goal of moral reasoning. However, there may be psychological or cultural boundary conditions to this strategy that drive some individuals toward moral consistency.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者提出未来研究应探讨什么导致群体中混合道德策略的发展，并指出可能存在心理或文化边界条件驱使某些个体走向道德一致性。
